title: Yellow Smoked Ukrainian Penne Pasta
description: A spicy and crumbly Ukrainian dish featuring penne pasta, smoke, and flexitarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chopped onion and cook until translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant
Add the sliced vegetarian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Add the diced yellow pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes
Stir in the smoked paprika, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Drain the cooked penne pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce
Reduce heat to low and simmer the pasta for 2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
Serve the Yellow Smoked Ukrainian Penne Pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
